title: fix(agents): fall back to the primary's CLI runtime when the derived utility model has no credential
body:
Closes #138789

## What Problem This Solves

A primary model pinned to an eligible CLI runtime loses that runtime when background work selects the provider's automatic utility model. CLI-only installations consequently attempt HTTP authentication and fail for a missing provider key.

Automatic utility work now borrows the eligible primary runtime when the derived model lacks usable provider credentials. Credentialed HTTP routing and explicit utility/runtime selections keep their existing behavior.

## Changes

- Keep eligibility in utility selection and the current credential decision in execution preparation.
- Reconsider borrowed or failed preparations in the observer and narrator cache owners; keep successful non-borrowed preparations reusable.
- Share selection with the prepared-catalog display introduced by [#160884](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160884), using its existing readiness evaluator.

The [CLI backend documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) describes the choice. No new configuration option, schema, protocol, timeout or retry policy is introduced.

## Evidence

Candidate `e54c5895` incorporates landed [#148089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148089), retaining all 12 qualified feature files and contributor history.

- Paired regressions: narrator 3 failures before → 31 passing owner/cancellation cases; prepared catalog 2 failures before → 8 passing cases.
- Fresh actual dependencies and build passed. **9/9 OAuth cases and 105/105 feature/probe controls passed.** The prior hosted OAuth failure came from the shared mock export/import cycle repaired by [#148089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148089).
- Both real built Gateway checks passed: `system.info` and `models.list` choose API with a synthetic host key and Claude CLI without it. Real Claude 2.1.219 supplied local auth status; no inference was requested.
- The full changed gate and scoped P0 review remain attributed to `f66ad633`. Fresh [exact-head hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36961774521) and the required aggregate gate passed. Native preparation and merge passed; landed as `2dd93a290b748686160b4a478b7ee003cc0f9f24`.

The [original real inference proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157867#issuecomment-5881009546) used Claude 2.1.284 and saved API authentication. It does not prove subscription auth or a successful observer digest. The historical Linux shared-state failure was not reproduced on Darwin and is not claimed fixed.

Production **+134/-19 (net +115)**; tests/support **+615/-2**; docs **+26**. Growth supplies automatic borrowing and cache ownership while reusing the catalog decision owner.

Original implementation and evidence: **Mitchell Etzel (@etzelm)**. Contributor commits and credit are preserved.
